verdict.rationale: Portkey's first-party fallbacks docs describe configuring a prioritized list of providers and models with automatic fallback when the primary fails. Trigger conditions are customizable via on_status_codes, and circuit protection and log filtering by Config ID are also documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that fallback works in production.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can configure automatic fallback to another model or provider when one fails

citations.quote: Specify a prioritized list of providers/models. If the primary LLM fails, Portkey automatically falls back to the next in line.
By default, fallback triggers on any **non-2xx** status code. Customize with `on_status_codes`
Configure per-strategy circuit protection and failure handling
